title: Marcker's General Electric experiment testing for spacetime torsion

tellings.quote: he did an experiment that was specifically designed to test whether torsion existed in space time and it was a wellth out apparatus very welld designed they did it at General Electric

plain: On the podcast of a host named Jesse Michels, a researcher named Eric Davis says that a scientist he calls Marcker ran an experiment at General Electric, the big American engineering company, to test whether spacetime has "torsion", a kind of twist in the fabric of space and time. Davis describes the equipment as well thought out and very well designed. He tells it because finding such a twist would point to physics beyond the usual textbook picture.
